name: sapia
description: Sapia – a modern editor for text-based diagrams (PlantUML, Mermaid, and more via plugins).

scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @sapia/web && npm run build -w @sapia/desktop
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @sapia/core && npm run build -w @sapia/plugin-plantuml -w @sapia/plugin-mermaid
